market_summary: London morning session exhibits tight compression across FX pairs and BTCUSD. EURUSD and GBPUSD are recovering above their session VWAPs but remain trapped inside their respective Value Areas directly below session high resistance and POC levels, lacking RVOL > 2.0 breakout participation. BTCUSD continues its structural downtrend below VWAP and VAL, but is presently stalling between local support and resistance levels without expansion volume. All three symbols warrant HOLD pending clear breakout or rejection catalysts.

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10773, VAH 1.10981) and trading just below POC 1.10946. 2) CVD: +3587 (BULLISH) with a strongly positive slope (+2001.89), agreeing with upward pressure. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION (non-blocking). 4) Trend: price is firmly above session VWAP (1.10847) and baseline EMA50 (1.10878), both sloping positively. 5) ATR band: price is in upper half of ATR channel (1.10939 vs upper 1.10968), not overextended. 6) Volume/RVOL: rvol_last is 0.892 (no yellow bar breakout yet), indicating compression. 7) S/R: price is capped just below Session High (1.10988) while holding above Prev Low / EMA50 support. Without a breakout confirmation or pullback to VWAP, risk/reward is limited inside VA near resistance. Recommendation is HOLD.

signals.level_event: acceptance / holding above EMA50 and testing Session High

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593, VAH 1.32797) and below POC 1.32738. 2) CVD: -2610 (BEARISH) showing negative overall session delta, diverging from the current price rise above VWAP (although short-term slope is +774.22). 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend: price holds above VWAP (1.32661) and EMA50 (1.32693). 5) ATR band: price is mid-channel between EMA20 (1.32665) and upper ATR band (1.32796). 6) Volume/RVOL: rvol_last is 1.039 with no yellow breakout volume spike. 7) S/R: rejected at Session High (1.32809) with a small upper wick on signal candle. Due to CVD divergence, location directly under POC/VAH, and lack of breakout volume, setup lacks confluence for an entry. Recommendation is HOLD.

signals.level_event: rejection / upper wick near Session High resistance

signals.rationale: Evaluating 7-point confluence checklist: 1) VP context: price is below VAL (73416.41) and well below POC (73541.61), confirming bearish value acceptance. 2) CVD: -0.04 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.01), agreeing with the downtrend. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend: clearly bearish, consistently holding below downward sloping VWAP (73625.7) and EMA50 (73640.0). 5) ATR band: consolidating in the lower half of ATR channel (near EMA20 baseline 73466.09, lower band at 73123.4). 6) Volume/RVOL: rvol_last is 1.188, no RVOL > 2.0 yellow breakout spikes. 7) S/R: currently trapped in a narrow range between local S/R resistance at 73386.8 and support at 73284.6/Session Low 73166.0. Forming bar shows an inside consolidation without momentum trigger. Recommendation is HOLD.
